q: Who designed Your Rainbow Panorama, Din regnbueudsigt, which is placed on top of the art museum ARoS in Aarhus?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2021 exam.

da.q: Hvem har designet ”Your rainbow panorama” (Din regnbueudsigt), der er placeret oven på kunstmuseet ARoS i Aarhus?

learn.text: Another artist who has made a mark in recent decades is the Danish-Icelandic Olafur Eliasson, born 1967. One of his best-known works is Your Rainbow Panorama, in Danish Din regnbueudsigt, from 2011, on top of the art museum ARoS in Aarhus, which is a 150-metre-long circular glass walkway where you can look out over Aarhus in all the colours of the rainbow.

q: In which town in Jutland did Anna Ancher and Michael Ancher paint especially many of their pictures at the end of the 1800s?

da.q: Ved hvilken by i Jylland malede Anna Ancher og Michael Ancher særligt mange af deres billeder i slutningen af 1800-tallet?

learn.text: Krøyer, who lived from 1851 to 1909, and the married couple Anna Ancher, 1859 to 1935, and Michael Ancher, 1849 to 1927, who belong to the circle of the so-called Skagen Painters.
